sources.quote: City Proposal: Charter Amendment 1 What is on the ballot? “Shall the City of Ferndale, Charter, Chapter IV, Registration, Nomination and Election, Section 5, Resignation of Commissioner [Council member], be deleted and repealed?” What is the current process? Currently, Councilmembers must resign to run for Mayor unless their term ends in the same election year. City Council then fills the remainder of the term with an appointed member. What happens if this is passed by voters? If approved, City Councilmembers running for Mayor would not need to resign their Council positions.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Repeals the charter rule requiring a councilmember to resign before running for mayor unless the council term ends in that same election year. Councilmembers could run for mayor without resigning their council positions.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Allow councilmembers to run for mayor without resigning.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the existing resignation rule, including the exception when the council term ends in the same election year.
